title: DECISION: Chat.receiptSharing optional (absent means inherit)
description: Chat.receiptSharing is typed as 'Boolean, optional'. When absent, the account-level PresenceStatus.receiptSharing applies. This three-state model (explicitly true, explicitly false, unset/inherit) is better than requiring an explicit value on every Chat record. Most chats will never need a per-chat override; requiring an explicit value would bloat every Chat object and force clients to read and echo the account-level setting on every Chat/set create. Absence-means-inherit keeps the common case simple, allows the global default to cascade without client complexity, and is consistent with how other JMAP per-object overrides work (e.g., per-message vs. account settings in JMAP Mail).
